concerns.text: FR-004 mandates 'Principal Component Regression (PCR)'. Tasks T032 (PCA) and T033 (PLS) implement Partial Least Squares Regression instead. While the plan justifies this switch, the tasks do not implement the specific requirement (PCR) defined in the spec, constituting a semantic weakening of the functional requirement.

SC-006 requires the standard deviation of decay rates to be '< 1% of the mean' as a pass/fail criterion. Task T024 only mandates generating a 'variance plot'. There is no task to programmatically calculate the ratio and enforce the <1% threshold, leaving the success criterion untestable by the implementation.

The spec's Edge Cases explicitly require handling 'resonance' (negative decay rates) by flagging and excluding them. Task T027 only mentions 'non-convergence' error handling. While T023 mentions detection, the specific task to 'flag and exclude' resonant instances from the regression dataset is missing, risking data contamination.

FR-009 requires reporting 'loadings of the topological metrics on the first two principal components'. Task T039 generates a 'loadings table' but does not explicitly ensure the output contains the *metric* loadings (as opposed to PLS weights or VIP scores), risking a mismatch in the specific data artifact required by the spec.
